name: Techwear
summary: City dress made of technical outdoor cloth. A black membrane shell with taped seams, many pockets, straps and quick buckles, with a cut for motion in the street.

philosophy.core_thesis: The city is a hard environment. Dress for it as for a mountain, with a shell, a system of pockets and straps, and a black, sealed surface.
design_principles: Cut the shell from a 3-layer membrane laminate and tape each seam.
Build 10 to 20 pockets into the garment so that no bag is needed.
Use a metal or a polymer quick-release buckle, rated for the load.
Cut articulated knees and elbows that follow a 3-D pattern.
Dye the whole garment black or in a dark neutral for a single surface.
Add a modular system: a hood, a detachable collar and a snap-in layer.
Fit a water-resistant zip with a storm flap along each seam line.
anti_patterns: A pocket for show that holds nothing
A loose, shapeless cut that catches on a door
A mass of logos and slogans

silhouette.shape: A sculpted, articulated black shell and a tapered trouser with many pockets, straps and a quick buckle.
silhouette.line: A sharp, structured shoulder, a long, articulated sleeve and a tapered ankle.
silhouette.fit: Roomy but cut in 3-D; a tapered leg and a close hem keep the line clean.
silhouette.proportion: Jacket to the hip or the thigh; roughly 1 to 1.1 chest to hip; tapered ankle of 16 to 20 cm.
rules: Make the garment in black or a single dark neutral.
Tape the seams and seal the zips on each shell.
Add a removable hood and a high collar that closes over the chin.
Place the pockets so that the arm reaches them with no strain.
Use a quick buckle at the waist, the ankle and the cuff.

fabrics.rule: Choose a laminated membrane and a tough nylon, dyed black, with metal and polymer hardware: the cloth and the hardware must look like gear.

construction.closures: A sealed zip with a storm flap, a magnetic or snap closure on a pocket, and a quick-release buckle.
construction.details: A removable hood, a high collar, many zip pockets, straps and loops, and a pattern with articulated knees and elbows.

surface.pattern: Plain black; a faint tonal pattern in the weave.
surface.gloss: A matte face at 5–15 GU; a laminated shell at 15–35 GU.
surface.wear: The garment looks new for years; the dye fades only at the fold, and the owner replaces a buckle, not the shell.

palette.strategy: Black first, with graphite, olive and a dark sand as the second tones.

making.scale: Made in small runs by studios and labels, at a high cost for each garment, for an urban buyer.
making.signs: An all-black surface, taped seams, a modular hood, many pockets and a quick-release buckle.

pieces.form: Black three-layer shell with a modular hood and many pockets
Tapered, articulated trouser with zip pockets and a buckle
Utility vest with a chest rig of pockets and straps
Long modular parka with a detachable liner

evidence.title: Black technical garment with removable badge

emotion.target_response: A cool, guarded sense of readiness: the wearer looks sealed, armoured and in control of the city.

use_cases: a product brief for a technical city jacket
an image prompt for a night city scene
a costume brief for a near-future film
a study note on gear in dress
avoid_when: the brief is heritage or rustic
the brief wants bright, soft colour

modifiers.how: Swap black for bright blocks, add a fleece and cut the lines looser.
Swap the membrane for a cotton drill, add a storm flap and a belt, and keep the pockets.

ornament_level.note: Hardware, straps and pockets serve as ornament; the cloth stays plain.
